instructions.question: What overall sentiment or emotional tone does the tweet's author express toward its topic or situation?
instructions.rule: Label by the tweet's overall tone, including mood about the author's own day; plain announcements, facts, questions and sports analysis are neutral unless they carry clear excitement, praise, complaint or hostility. Event promos and fan anticipation ('who's going?!', 'can't wait') count as positive; reports of violence, death, conflict, disputes, disappointment or insults count as negative even when worded factually. Sarcasm, jokes about others, or mild annoyance lean negative; if no feeling is detectable, choose neutral.

neutral.what: Factual news, schedules, questions, trivia, sports commentary or predictions, and casual remarks without clear feeling.
examples: May I be the first to remind you: Daylight Saving Time ends this weekend. Set clocks back at 2AM Sunday
Dana White says the Ronda Rousey and Holly Holm rematch will likely take place in July
David Price should not have been pitching in the 8th. They can't get a 6-outs from the bullpen? Yankees - Jays
neutral.cues: who's, will be, takes place, starting, reports, decided, Dec 28, I think
neutral.not_for: Factual reports of killings, attacks, disputes or boos are negative; announcements with exclamation and hype are positive.

positive.what: Excitement, anticipation, praise, happiness, support, good wishes, or upbeat promotion of events, people, teams or products.
examples: Jurassic World is back in @user theaters for one week starting Friday! Who's going?!
noel fielding may be one of the greatest people alive.
holy shit holy shit holy shit just found out I'm gonna see Paul McCartney tomorrow!!!!!!!!!
positive.cues: can't wait, awesome, amazing, happiest, excited, love, great, congratulations, get well soon, hope, don't miss, !!!, :)
positive.not_for: Neutral listings of concerts or schedules without enthusiasm stay neutral; mocking excitement ('can't wait to see the Cowboys ruin the jets' is still positive, but pure ridicule is negative).

negative.what: Complaints, disappointment, anger, insults, threats, sarcasm, criticism of people or groups, or reports of violence, death and conflict.
examples: Everything about Brownsville is just bad and depressing. Can’t wait to go back home tomorrow.
West Indies to pull off from the India tour after the 4th ODI in Dharamsala owing to pay dispute with their Board.
I missed the Barcelona game yesterday.
negative.cues: worse, bad, depressing, wtf, kill, died, shot dead, punish, booed, :(, still haven't, pathetic, beat the fuck outta
negative.not_for: Mild sports criticism or speculation without emotion is neutral; jokey threats toward rivals inside clearly happy tweets stay positive.
